title: An ended run's dispatched row for an open tick still grows a live elapsed
description:
isLiveAttempt treats the newest run's dispatched/reported row as a live attempt without checking whether that run itself ended, so a dead subject run's stale 'dispatched' row for a tick the tracker has NOT closed still shows a per-tick countdown that only grows. The run-level clock freezes at the run's end (runEndedAt); the per-tick one does not. Outside tick cno's scope, which is exactly the tracker-closed case.
evidence: internal/statusmodel/build.go:483-491 (isLiveAttempt): owner == len(PriorRecords) && state == tickDispatched answers live with no runEnded check

ticfac run epic-hn6 filed this backlog tick from the finding 022dcae80f21a80eec2332cecdf0b4ff0e67077c5117c230df067b54f3b12dc2 (reported by run-epic-hn6/tick-cno/attempt-26): the done is reachable with the finding standing, so it is a backlog tick with an owner rather than the epic's to absorb. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-hn6/absorptions/022dcae80f21a80eec2332cecdf0b4ff0e67077c5117c230df067b54f3b12dc2.json on the run branch.
